arguments.where_clause: merchant_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE mcc = 5311)
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose merchant is classified under MCC 5311 (department stores), regardless of amount, card or channel.
assumptions: 'Department stores' means merchants whose mcc column equals 5311 in the merchants table.
No amount, card type, channel or date filter is applied; the rule flags all transactions at those merchants.
